datasets.name: RobustAD: A Realworld Anomaly Detection Dataset for Robustness
datasets.role: industrial visual anomaly detection; evaluation of robustness to real-world distribution shifts
datasets.summary: Three industrial anomaly-detection subsets: MetalParts (automotive metal parts), PCB (printed circuit boards), and PiledBags (piled packets). Training uses source-domain data; test splits cover target domains. MetalParts and PCB support localization and classification; PiledBags supports classification.
datasets.schema: Images are organized by object and train/test domain directories. MetalParts and PCB provide metadata.jsonl with file_name, label (0 normal, 1 anomaly), and mask (null for normal, relative mask path for anomalies). PiledBags provides imagefolder-compatible split directories and metadata. See upstream README.md.
datasets.taxonomy: Normal (label 0) and anomaly (label 1). Named defect types vary by subset and appear in paths/metadata; PCB and MetalParts include pixel masks for anomalous examples. PiledBags labels the anomaly count/arrangement task.
datasets.citation: Upstream dataset card says citation/paper is coming soon; no formal citation supplied.
